title: PMCompliance
description: Planned-vs-executed preventive maintenance compliance assessment for an asset in an analysis window. Feeds Step 5 causal scoring directly.

asset_id.description: Asset identifier — must resolve to a KG Asset node.

event_id.description: Event under analysis — optional, used for traceability and staleness review (PM Compliance module).

assessment_date.description: When this assessment was generated (or as-of / event time). See PM_Compliance_Module_Architecture.md.

look_back_window_days.description: CMMS/schedule lookback horizon used for this artifact.

fmea_pm_linkage_available.description: True when KG provides explicit PM task ↔ failure mode tags (or equivalent); when false, scope analysis is advisory only.

data_quality_notes.description: Human-readable caveats (missing WOs, partial export, CBM not evaluated, etc.).

components.description: Per-component PM detail (module extension). When absent, use checks[] + summary only.

check_id.description: PM task ID from CMMS or surveillance requirement ID.

check_type.description: Type of PM task — disambiguates check_id semantics.

source_ref.description: Resolving reference: PM task ID in CMMS, or SOP section (e.g., 'SOP-4321 §3.2'). Must trace to a document.json or KG node.

overdue_by_days.description: Days past scheduled date at time of event. Populated only if status != pass.

evidence_refs.description: doc_id references (type WO) that confirm execution. Must resolve to document.json records.

component_id.description: KG Component node ID that this PM check covers. When present, used for direct structural matching in governance scoring instead of keyword heuristics.

applicable_fm_ids.description: KG FailureMode node IDs explicitly targeted by this PM check (e.g., a surveillance test designed to verify a specific trip function). Optional override that narrows governance scoring to specific failure modes.

wo_id.description: Closing WO for the PM execution; copied into governance rationale by Stage D.

overdue_items.description: Explicit overdue PM index — aggregated from checks[] for direct consumption by Step 5 causal scoring without re-parsing checks array.

summary.description: Structured aggregate — directly consumable by orchestrator and Step 5 scoring without parsing checks[].

overdue_count.description: Number of checks not completed by scheduled date.

compliance_rate.description: Fraction of checks passed: passed / total_checks. Used as a normalized compliance signal in Step 5 evidence scoring.
